name: 天机蛊
reference_role: 仅卡框、比例、可信光影材质，非身体和背景

evidence.chapter: chapter_1494｜第四百五十六节：天机蛊成！
evidence.excerpt: 身体很是细长，像是柳枝，十分柔软。柳枝的两侧分别是七片羽翼，薄如轻纱

design_boundary: 柳枝形、七对羽翼、轻纱绿色和缓飘为原著锚。叶脉、具体绿色和细节材质为设计。v1只有六对大翼，v2定点修正，未将错误版作为完成。
prompt: Edit ONLY wing count/attachment structure in supplied Tian Ji Gu card. Preserve the thin silver double-line rounded card frame, entire muted green-grey composition, very slender soft willow-twig body, airy translucent leaf membrane material and physical light. The current branch has too few reliably readable complete wing pairs and small extra leafy buds. Replace the wing arrangement with EXACTLY SEVEN clear pairs: SEVEN full translucent narrow willow-leaf wings on the left and SEVEN full translucent narrow willow-leaf wings on the right, each opposing pair rooted at one of SEVEN distinct spaced nodes on a single central body. Fourteen total complete wings, no overlap hiding roots, no extra little leaves or sprouts. Make all seven pair-nodes easy to count, evenly spaced along diagonal twig. Use a compact narrower wing spread to keep every tip inside the border. No numbers/labels in image. Keep everything else unchanged; do not add normal dragonfly head, beetle legs, insect eyes, gold decorations or background. This is a minimal anatomical count correction not a new style.

inspection.verdict: 可用：七个翼对节点可逐对辨认，共14片主要薄翼
visible_facts: 单一细长柔柳枝，两侧各七片绿色半透明叶翼
无多余小芽、普通蜻蜓四翼或纸白蜈蚣身体；卡框与光影保持
risks: 柳枝主体偏枝条，蜻蜓首观感弱；原文双重相似由叶翼漂浮表达
翼脉和弯曲方向属设计，不锁本体植物学品种
